also: I can’t make head or tail of it

terms.gloss: neither head nor foot: neither beginning nor end
evidence: Plaut. Asin. 729b: Quīn nec caput nec pēs sermōnī appāret.
Cic. Fam. 7.31.2: nec caput nec pedēs (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: With appāret and a dative of the thing that makes no sense.

phrases.latin: Quīn nec caput nec pēs sermōnī appāret.
phrases.english: Why, there’s neither head nor tail to be seen in what you say.

sources: Lewis & Short: caput
